workouts.title: Overview
workouts.description:
This is the 50/50 week after 3 weeks of 80/20 in our second cyle of the Fitness Phase. This refers to the volume/intensity split. So this week will be more focused on intensity than the first 3 weeks. 
Goodluck, and make sure you have fun.
